data.plainLyric:
You and me
We got an understandin'
'Cause where we come from
There ain't much hope to be found

In a town like this
Where there's a chance in a million
You gotta break some rule, babe
'Cause there ain't enough to go 'round

Time is runnin' out
For some fool every minute
They're burnin' out like shootin' stars
As they drop into the neon night

But with you, I almost feel
That the odds are in my favor
All at once, I know I'm not afraid
Of startin', of startin' from zero

If tomorrow never comes
Why fret 'bout what you ain't got yet?
Gotta hustle in the moment
You gotta work for what you get

'Cause in a place like this
You are dealin' with the devil
But you still gotta have some faith
When you're startin', startin' from zero

Startin', startin' from zero
When you're startin', startin' from zero
Startin', startin' from zero
When you're startin', startin' from zero
